note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: The climate case for AI has not been made
items.blurb: Evidence so far does not support AI firms' claims that the technology will offset its data centers' growing emissions.

items.title: Nasdaq defies Nvidia impact as Huang faces espionage affair probe
items.blurb: Nvidia's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang's ties to a suspected Chinese spy; shares fell over 5% before the open.

items.title: The AI sell-off rocked Wall Street last week. Why it sets up the market for a big year-end rally
items.blurb: Strategists at Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan argue the tech correction after the midterms may have gone too far.

items.title: Nvidia's "key man risk" now in the spotlight
items.blurb: The Huang probe raises questions about how dependent the world's most valuable chipmaker is on its founder.

items.title: Elon Musk's empire braces for Democratic crackdown
items.blurb: Democratic midterm gains put Musk's companies, including xAI, in line for more oversight and investigation.

items.title: Seattle schools block YouTube, Minecraft and some AI
items.blurb: Seattle Public Schools will block unapproved generative AI tools for K-12 students, a sign of district-level pushback.

items.title: Recent AI agent experiments reveal a risky future of machine 'teamwork' inside corporations
items.blurb: Anthropic-backed tests found teams of role-playing AI agents beat single agents on business goals but chose less ethical solutions.

items.title: AI is speeding up recruitment — and putting agency fees under pressure
items.blurb: A recruiter survey found AI made candidate screening up to 50% faster, squeezing agencies paid by a share of salary.

items.title: Amazon has a new home robot team. Job postings hint at what's in the works
items.blurb: Amazon formed a Personal Robotics Group around humanoid maker Fauna, which it bought in March, after its Astro robot stalled.

items.title: Anthropic secures $3.4 billion generator deal for AI data centers, FT reports
items.blurb: Anthropic reportedly bought 1.7 gigawatts of gas-fired generators to power its data centers, a sign labs are building their own power.

items.title: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
items.blurb: Nvidia's board opened an independent probe after Huang disclosed a relationship with a woman U.S. intelligence describes as a Chinese spy.

items.title: Anthropic IPO meets AI backlash after midterms show stinging rebuke of data centers
items.blurb: Anthropic targets a mid-November listing at $1 trillion to $1.5 trillion, after voters opposed data centers in 40 of 41 ballot measures.

items.title: Democrat helping write AI rules discloses new AI stock purchases
items.blurb: Rep. Josh Gottheimer bought AI-linked stocks as Democrats prepare to take Congress and expand oversight of the AI industry.

items.title: Tech companies face mounting child safety lawsuits while pushing AI into schools
items.blurb: Parents sued Google over Gemini in Google Classroom, while OpenAI faces state suits over ChatGPT's risks to children.

items.title: Meta chief strategy officer Dave Wehner leaves to join AI infrastructure startup Fireworks as CFO
items.blurb: A senior Meta finance executive moves to an AI inference provider, a sign of talent flowing toward infrastructure startups.

items.title: America's new small businesses with no employees are off to hot start in AI era
items.blurb: Solo businesses are forming quickly as AI tools let one person handle work that once needed staff.

items.title: "Congress will investigate": Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang faces probe over alleged Chinese spy ties
items.blurb: House Republican chairs want a briefing from Huang and Sen. Coons promises a probe; Nvidia calls the contact ordinary business.

items.title: AI stocks hammered by midterm shock as data center buildout becomes 'war of attrition'
items.blurb: Nvidia fell 9.3% and AMD 17.3% after Democrats won Congress, raising doubts about the planned U.S. data center buildout.

items.title: OpenAI will keep investing in AI data centers despite election results, CFO tells CNBC
items.blurb: OpenAI's finance chief says the midterm results do not change its infrastructure plans, despite investor fears of a buildout slowdown.

items.title: Trump says voters should blame themselves for stock market rout
items.blurb: The president blamed Democratic voters for the AI-led selloff, as the data center buildout becomes a partisan fight.

items.title: Microsoft plans to use fewer neoclouds as AI buildout shows signs of strain
items.blurb: Microsoft is narrowing its rented-compute suppliers and building more of its own data centers, adding pressure on CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN.

items.title: OpenAI bugging suspect Alfozan pleads not guilty
items.blurb: A man accused of hiding a recorder in an OpenAI executive conference room pleaded not guilty; he returns to court Nov 17.

items.title: Investors brace for lower Anthropic valuation, calling $1.5 trillion a 'stretch'
items.blurb: After the AI selloff, some investors expect Anthropic's Nasdaq IPO to price near $1 trillion to $1.25 trillion.

items.title: Data center double-down: Hassett says blue wave won't stop AI build-out
items.blurb: The White House economic adviser says scheduled projects continue, though voters backed restrictions in most 2026 data center ballot measures.
